# Server start and the session commands of C2.3: tmux's command lookup, argument errors and
# session targets, and the errors with no server. Panes run fixed commands, never a shell.
run has-session
run kill-server
run kill-session -t a
run nosuch
run new-session -d -s a 'exec sleep 100'
run new-session -d -s a
run new-session -d -s b -c / -n win exec sleep 100
run has-session -t a
run has-session -t =a
run has-session -t a:0
run has-session -t $0
run has-session -t $99
run has-session -t =nope
run has-session -t nope
run has-session -t 'b*'
run has-session
run has-session -t
run has-session extra
run has-session -%
run has-session -?
run kill-session -t a extra
run new-session -z
run new-session -d -x abc
run new-session -d -x 0 -s q 'exec sleep 100'
run new-session -d -x 65536 -s q 'exec sleep 100'
run new
run ne
run kill-s
run rename-session
run kill-server -?
run new-session -d -s c 'exec sleep 100' ; has-session -t c ; has-session -t zz ; kill-session -t c
run has-session -t c
run kill-session -t a
run has-session -t a
run start-server
run kill-server
